groupedCrossValidation.policy: connected components of all 44 source PUUIDs present in a game; all ten people and the whole game stay in one fold

selectionObjective: highest grouped out-of-fold end-to-end keyword accuracy, then macro F1, then less smoothing / renormalize

pointCorrelation.definition: per-participant Pearson correlation after interpolating our minute curve to OP.GG seconds; same participant, no scores borrowed
